note: Not the final fitted-model lock. Selected hyperparameters and numerical threshold are appended to a separate final lock after development CV and before single final test.

validation.reason_for_no_extra_fold: Maintain the three predeclared, audited windows before seeing model results; the post-stress 1992–1993 window is the lower-prevalence validation regime. A new fold would require a new preselection protocol version.
validation.repeated_bank_rows_handling: No random rowsplit; grouped-CERT bootstrap for uncertainty, report positive CERTs separately from bank-quarter positives.

feature_policy.tier2_candidates: not included in the primary comparison; source coverage may be descriptive only until a versioned amended protocol and independent as-of audit
feature_policy.growth_missingness_ablation: predeclared secondary robustness model excluding the two growth missing indicators; no test-driven choice
feature_policy.clipping_decision_rule: Within each classifier family select clipping jointly with other hyperparameters by highest unweighted mean validation Average Precision over the three registered folds. Scores within absolute AP 0.0002 are treated as a tie; choose quantile_1_99 to limit outlier influence. All transforms fitted inside training folds only.

model_selection.model_selection_tie_break: If absolute AP difference <=0.0002, select less complex family (equity baseline, logistic_L2, then HistGradientBoosting); within a family prefer smaller capacity and precommitted clipping rule.
model_selection.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap sampling CERT not bank-quarters; report fold results independently; seed fixed

threshold_selection.data_source: positive development FAILURE transaction COST (thousands USD) as a proxy for resolution loss; not a direct observable cost of missed warning
threshold_selection.miss_cost_proxy_rule: median of strictly positive finite COST among qualifying development failures, computed without test outcomes; explain exclusions and sensitivity
threshold_selection.false_alarm_cost: unobserved; set as 0.05 times miss-cost proxy for primary scenario
threshold_selection.unit_of_alarm_cost: per alerted CERT and calendar year, to avoid counting each consecutive flagged quarter as an independent alert
threshold_selection.unit_of_missed_failure: each unique qualifying CERT failure event not alerted in a preceding four-quarter risk window
threshold_selection.threshold_grid: all unique development out-of-fold predicted probabilities with deterministic tie break; choose threshold minimizing observed development cost proxy subject to timing and calendar grouping; no test labels
threshold_selection.threshold_tie_break: higher threshold (fewer false alerts) among equal development cost values
threshold_selection.cost_assumption_limit: resolution COST != causal benefit of an early warning; false-positive cost is a scenario assumption

development_only_sensitivities.assistance_positive: FAILURE plus independently dated RESTYPE=ASSISTANCE within forward horizon; never replace primary label
development_only_sensitivities.adverse_exit_upper_bound: same 317 observations => 1, a bound not bank failure adjudication
development_only_sensitivities.legacy_censor: censor-on-nonfailure-exit V1 for selection sensitivity; no choice based on test outcome
development_only_sensitivities.execution: Use exclusively development for feature/model/threshold decisions

spark_demo.scope: one development fold only; parity of sklearn/Spark summaries; no test

test_policy.after_development_cv: Write separate FINAL_MODEL_LOCK.json with selected feature set, clipping, model hyperparameters, fitted preprocessing rules, numeric threshold, seed and SHA-256 of this protocol; then run a single final test evaluation and record immutable execution log.

limitations: Contemporary FDIC snapshot does not reconstruct every historical release vintage.
Preselection freeze does not claim any model has been trained, threshold selected or test evaluated.
CI coverage is descriptive given three validation windows and clustered failures.
